units.source_text: 从那之后，每隔两三天就有不同的河童来看我。

en.t: After that, different kappa came to visit me every two or three days.

units.source_text: 根据S博士的诊断，我得了早发性痴呆症。

en.t: According to Dr. S's diagnosis, I had early-onset dementia.

units.source_text: 但是查喀医生说，我并没有得这个病，得早发性痴呆症的是S博士和你们自己。

en.t: But Dr. Chack said that I did not have the illness, and that the ones with early-onset dementia were Dr. S and all of you yourselves.

units.source_text: （虽然我这么说可能对你有点失礼。）

en.t: Though it may be a little rude of me to say so to you.

units.source_text: 连医生查喀都来看我了，学生拉卟和哲学家马咯当然也来了。

en.t: Even Dr. Chack came to see me, so of course the student Lapp and the philosopher Maro came as well.

units.source_text: 但是除了渔夫巴咯敢白天来，其他人都是夜晚才会出现。

en.t: But except for the fisherman Baro, who dared to come by day, the others would appear only at night.

units.source_text: 天只要一黑——尤其月夜，它们就三三两两地搭伴儿一道来了。

en.t: As soon as it grew dark, especially on moonlit nights, they came in twos and threes, keeping one another company.

units.source_text: 昨天晚上，趁着月夜的光，我还和玻璃公司老板嘎尔以及哲学家马咯一起交谈了呢。

en.t: Last night, by the light of the moon, I even talked with Gar, the owner of the glass company, and with the philosopher Maro.

units.source_text: 音乐家库拉巴喀还用小提琴为我弹奏了一支优美的曲子。

en.t: The musician Kurabakka also played a beautiful piece for me on the violin.

units.source_text: 喏，看到那边桌子上的一束黑百合花吗？

en.t: Look, do you see that bunch of black lilies on the table over there?

units.source_text: 那是昨天晚上库拉巴喀给我带来的礼物……

en.t: That is the gift Kurabakka brought me last night...
